name: trailhead-eslint
description: Lints the repo. A package of its own, as Bluebird's is: typescript-eslint reads the TypeScript compiler's JavaScript API at run time and accepts only TypeScript below 6.1, while the repo type-checks with TypeScript 7, whose package no longer ships that API. Record 0010. The minimatch override holds it at the release that fixes GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249: eslint and typescript-eslint still ask for 10, which has no fixed release. Drop it once their ranges reach 11.
